enumeration_note: Single taught short setup (25 EMA close-under channel-break continuation after 50 MA rejection), narrated via one live trade. Entry mechanics are runnable; exit target is somewhat gestural ("bottom level"/measured move) but the setup is clearly taught.

coaching_notes: "i gave enough time i don't want to wait too long"
"sometimes if you don't see that move in time then usually price goes back up"
"this price needs to break down soon otherwise it's gonna go either sideway or go back up"
"i'm getting ready to kill this trade if i see a close"
element_inventory: ENTRY (short): enter when a bar closes under the blue 25 EMA
PRECONDITION: price rejects the 50 MA with a weak close before entry
PRECONDITION: a down channel is forming / entry is the channel break to the downside
SCALE-IN: add a second contract on a pullback
INVALIDATION: do not want to see price close above the 25 EMA (would break channel upward) â€” kill the trade on such a close
STOP: initially placed above entry, then moved to break-even
TARGET: exit at the prior bottom level; expect a second leg roughly the same size as the first move down (measured move)
strategies.entry_summary: In a down channel after price rejects the 50-period MA with a weak close, wait for a bar to close under the blue 25 EMA; enter short on that confirmation (channel-break continuation down). Add a second contract on a pullback.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop initially above the entry/channel, moved to break-even once given enough time; target the prior bottom level (roughly a measured move equal to the first leg down). Speaker reports ~$1900 on two contracts.
strategies.name: ema25_channel_break_short
